entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 25, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Terraform

Community

  • Terraform and OpenTofu Skill for AI Agents (⭐2.5k) - Agent skill with Terraform and OpenTofu best practices for testing, module design, CI/CD workflows and production patterns. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kiro and other Agent Skills-compatible tools.

Tutorials and Blog Posts / Multi-Environment Configuration

  • Terraform Design Patterns: the Terrafile - Managing Terraform modules and their versions within Terraform projects with Terrafile.

Providers / Vendor supported providers

  • terraform-provider-aws (compliance.tf) (⭐4) - AWS provider for Terraform and OpenTofu by compliance.tf. Runs the unmodified hashicorp/aws provider and checks aws_* resources against compliance controls before apply. Warns by default; can fail the run in CI.

Tools / Community providers

  • ctfkit (⭐4) - Offline analyzer for Terraform and OpenTofu configuration, plans and module manifests. Writes SARIF findings. Needs no cloud credentials. Also available as a GitHub Action (⭐2).
  • modulestf (⭐377) - Agent skills for Claude Code and Codex that review, fix and maintain reusable Terraform modules by the rules of terraform-aws-modules. Rules: modules.tf/rules.
  • mtf-facts (⭐21) - Offline Go CLI that parses Terraform module trees and reports rule results, findings with evidence, and interface and provider schema diffs. Works as a standalone module linter.
  • repro-lambda (⭐15) - Builds byte-identical AWS Lambda packages on macOS and Linux, uploads them to S3 by content hash, and passes them to terraform-aws-lambda as s3_existing_package, so terraform plan builds nothing.

2. Discount for Student Dev

Learning Resources

  • TCM Security [DISCOUNT] - Practical, hands-on cybersecurity certifications (PNPT, PJPT and more). Students get a 20% off coupon.

3. Android Security Awesome

Tools / Misc Tools

  • rasp (⭐10) - Open-source RASP runtime that protects a built APK or AAB without source changes: root, debugger, Frida and hook, emulator and app-cloning checks

4. Awesome Agriculture

Research and General Data

  • Genomes to Fields Maize GxE Prediction Data - Plot-level maize yield and agronomic traits from multi-environment hybrid trials, 2014 to 2024, with weather, soil, management and hybrid genotypes, published by the Genomes to Fields Initiative under ODC PDDL (2022 edition).

5. Awesome Zig

Language Essentials / Command Line and Argument Parser

  • sirkon/dap (⭐3) - Declarative command-line argument parser for Zig with compile-time validation, subcommands, help, shell completions, extensive i18n support and command composition. AI-assisted.

6. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • agent-manager (⭐703) - Terminal UI that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other coding-agent CLIs, each in its own persistent tmux session. One list shows every session's live status, prompts go into a pane without attaching, a session can spawn into its own Git worktree, and a full-file diff review sends line comments back to the agent. Launches your installed Gemini CLI unmodified, so login, config and MCP servers carry over. macOS, Linux and Windows via WSL2. Apache-2.0.
  • Novadeck (⭐59) - Free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Antigravity CLI (agy), Gemini CLI's successor, side by side with Claude Code, Codex and opencode. Every agent's questions and permission asks land in one Inbox, and agents can message each other and start teammates in another harness.
  • Ralph Harness (⭐28) - Tiny Python scaffold for running Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and similar coding agents in guarded local loops. It uses repo-local specs, fresh-context iterations, hard caps, git-hook gates, CI verification, and coverage gates.
  • Bernstein (⭐1.2k) - Multi-agent orchestrator that coordinates Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code and Codex CLI. Spawns parallel coding agents from a single goal, verifies with tests, auto-commits. Deterministic Python coordination, zero LLM tokens on orchestration.
  • ToutKit (⭐11) - Desktop notebook with a built-in terminal that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code and Codex; an in-app webview renders whatever the agent writes inline, and each note is a self-contained folder with its own SQLite, files, and scripts. Local-first, Electron, AGPL-3.0.
  • Jackalope (⭐5) - Open-source desktop workspace that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agents, each task in its own git worktree, with diffs, checks and merge review in one view. Windows, macOS and Linux.

Commands & Extensions

  • llm-box (⭐16) - Terminal-first workflow automation engine. Generate and execute YAML workflows from plain English. 20+ built-in nodes (fetch_url, execute, file I/O, HTTP, JSON parsing, template rendering, LLM calls), 15+ LLM providers, and MCP server mode. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/alib8b8/llm-box.
  • AIHawk (⭐33k) - Gives Gemini CLI a real Firefox to drive from plain-English instructions: opens pages, clicks, types, reads and screenshots through the real pointer and keyboard. Open source, MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/feder-cr/AIHawk.
  • OsmO Phone Calls (⭐11) - Gemini CLI extension (GEMINI.md context + the remote MCP server https://api.getosmo.app/mcp) that has OsmO's voice AI phone businesses or helplines after you confirm, and returns the summary and transcript. OAuth sign-in with a phone number, no API key. 50 free credits for new users in the US, Canada, UK and Australia; paid after. With free credits, OsmO calls businesses and toll-free numbers; calling your contacts and scheduling calls need an OsmO app plan. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Mountainheads-Private-limited/osmo-ai-plugins.
  • QuoteMem (⭐7) - Gemini CLI extension for long-term memory shared with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and other agents through one local service: hooks save the chat and add the relevant memories to the context, each memory keeps the exact words it came from, updates keep the old version, and "forget ..." requests are carried out (npm install -g quotemem, quotemem setup, then quotemem install gemini).
  • Dopamine Talk (⭐6) - Agent Skills pack (dopamine-talk, dopamine-changelog, dopamine-readme) and a marker-managed GEMINI.md rules block that installs into Gemini CLI (~/.gemini/skills/ and ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md) and 20+ other coding agents without touching existing instructions. Cuts file-path narration, trailing hedging disclaimers, boilerplate padding, and unasked critic-gate suggestions. Ships separate native English and Russian editions; zero dependencies, MIT. Install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AnnenkovLabs/dopamine-talk/main/install.sh | sh.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • agnix (⭐495) - Linter for AI agent configurations. Validates GEMINI.md, SKILL.md, hooks, MCP, and more with 156 rules, auto-fix, and LSP server for real-time editor diagnostics.
  • Nix AI Tools (⭐2.3k) - Seamless Nix integration for reproducible Gemini CLI installations. Ensures consistent environments across teams and simplifies deployment with declarative configuration.

MCP Servers

  • nika (⭐101) - Read-only oracle for Nika AI workflows: validate .nika.yaml DAGs, explain findings, browse schema/examples, honest cost estimate — before a single token is spent (single Rust binary, config: command nika, args [mcp]).
  • CloudGPU MCP (⭐2) - MIT-licensed local (stdio) MCP server that lets Gemini CLI rent a GPU by the minute on CloudGPU, run a job, download the results and shut the machine down; the same key also works with an OpenAI-compatible API for open models. Needs a CloudGPU account with prepaid balance.
  • A1 Gallery - Hosted MCP server that lets Gemini CLI search a hand-picked gallery of real, live websites by style, font, colour and section, and read the type sizes, spacing and palette measured off each page. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth and a free A1 account: gemini mcp add --transport http a1 https://www.a1.gallery/api/mcp.
  • Public Records Data (⭐1) - Gemini CLI extension and hosted MCP servers for public-records and market data from 18 Apify Actors: US federal contracts and grants (SAM.gov, Grants.gov, USAspending), UK and EU tenders, city council meetings, ATS job postings, company social links, Etsy market research, competitor Google ads, sports odds, Spotify play counts, forecast track records and Skool community search. Tool calls run on your own Apify account (OAuth or API token). Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/GeminiGeorge22/publicrecords-skills.
  • LeadMerlin (⭐0) - MCP server that lets Gemini CLI search local businesses (Google Maps) by niche and city and enrich each one with owner name, emails checked against the mail server, phone line type (mobile/landline/VoIP) and website tech. Remote Streamable HTTP (gemini mcp add --transport http leadmerlin https://api.leadmerlin.com/mcp --header "x-api-key: lm_your_key") or local via npx -y github:HalberdLLC/leadmerlin-mcp (Node 18+, no dependencies). check_website_tech is free without a key; signup gives 100 free leads, no card. MIT.

Frameworks

  • Maestro (⭐492) - Turn Gemini CLI into a multi-agent platform — 12 specialized subagents, parallel dispatch, 4-phase orchestration, and standalone dev tools for code review, debugging, security, and performance.
  • Emdash Skills (⭐29) - 14-category autonomous product-building OS with 18 specialized agents. Turns one-line prompts into deployed products. Includes GEMINI.md compatibility for cross-tool portability. Skills cover architecture, planning, quality, brand, media, observability, and deployment on Cloudflare Workers.

Non-Gemini CLI

  • NotFair (⭐4.3k) - Open-source Claude Code skills for SEO, GEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads. Connects to live data via Google Ads MCP, Meta Ads MCP, Google Search Console MCP, and Google Analytics (GA4) MCP. Includes a /notfair:gemini cross-model review skill that runs Gemini as a second-opinion gate on ad campaigns, SEO metadata, and schema markup. MIT, ~2.9k stars.

7. Awesome Python Typing

Integrations / Mypy plugins

  • typeshed-stats (⭐15) - Library and command-line tool to gather stats on typeshed (⭐5.2k) packages.

8. Awesome Privacy

Speech to Text / Apps and services

  • Amical - Desktop dictation app that transcribes offline with open Whisper or Parakeet models and no account, with an optional paid cloud service. ⚠️ closed server macOS · Windows · MIT

9. Awesome Machine Learning

R / General-Purpose Machine Learning

  • CoxBoost - CoxBoost: Cox models by likelihood based boosting for a single survival endpoint or competing risks [Deprecated]

10. Awesome Bitcoin

Additional Resources

  • Hardware Wallet Security Incident Tracker - Dated record of hardware wallet security incidents (vulnerabilities, supply-chain tampering, vendor data breaches), each with its sources, the affected models and whether it is fixed. Open data under CC BY 4.0.

11. Typography

Tools

  • Fonts Ninja - Free browser extension that identifies the fonts used on any website, with size, line height, letter spacing and color.
  • A1 Fonts - The 570+ typefaces used on hand-picked live websites, most used first, with the real sites that use each font.

12. Magictools

Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

  • 🆓 SpriteForge Image to Pixel Art - Free browser image-to-pixel-art converter: 16-128 px wide, 4-32 colours or palettes like PICO-8, dithering and outline; PNG download, nothing uploaded.

Graphics / Texture Tools

  • 🆓 SpriteForge Pixel Art Normal Map - Free browser normal map generator for pixel art sprites and sheets, with a moving-light preview and per-colour height; PNG for Unity and Godot, nothing uploaded.

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 💸 RBXGFX - AI generator for 1920x1080 Roblox game thumbnails and 512x512 icons that produces multiple distinct compositions per request, plus free browser-based Roblox image resizer and safe-zone preview utilities (5 free signup credits; paid plans available; not affiliated with Roblox Corporation).
  • 🆓 SpriteForge Pixel Art Maker - Free browser pixel art editor with layers, animation frames and onion skin, Aseprite-style keys, and PNG, GIF, sprite sheet or .aseprite export; no account.

Graphics / Modeling

  • 🆓 Mint Polycount Checker - Check a GLB/glTF model's triangles, vertices, draw calls and texture memory against game budgets (including Roblox's per-mesh limit) in the browser; free, no signup, nothing uploaded.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Tyrbo - AI agent that makes mobile games from a description: plans the game with concept art, builds it with its art, 2D and 3D animation and sound, tests it by playing it, and runs it on your phone from a QR code.

Collections / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 CSAF Music Library - 2,618 royalty free game music tracks in 59 albums, OGG and editable MIDI, with a free demo of one full track from every album. Composed by code written with AI tools, with no generative audio model.
  • 🆓 Ember Audio Free Sampler - 30 game audio files in OGG, with one music track, one seamless ambience loop and one SFX from each of 10 settings (dungeon, cyberpunk, cozy farm, western, cosmic horror, tavern, sci-fi, feudal Japan, post-apocalypse, pirates); royalty-free for commercial use, no attribution required. AI-generated (Suno for music, Stable Audio Open for loops and SFX) and hand-curated.
  • 💸 RFTracks - Royalty free music for games made with AI tools, filterable by mood, genre and tempo, MP3 downloads; free for commercial games with a credit link to RFTracks, paid plans without credit.

Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Apps66 Game Audio Converter - Online vgmstream + FFmpeg decoder for FMOD FSB5, Wwise WEM/BNK, Nintendo BFSTM/BCSTM/BRSTM, CRIWARE HCA/ADX/AWB, and XACT XWB sound banks to WAV/MP3/OGG/FLAC/M4A with audio preview and multi-track ZIP extraction (free tier up to 50 MB / 3 conversions per 24h).

Project Management / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 Overheard Calendar - Submission deadlines for indie game festivals, showcases, awards, Steam events and funds, each checked on the organiser's page

13. Awesome Mqtt

Brokers

  • PLCcom MQTT Standalone Broker - Free MQTT broker for Windows. MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0 over TLS, TCP and WebSocket, several listeners, access control.

Tools

  • PLCcom MQTT Client Tool - Free MQTT client for Windows. MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0 over TLS, TCP and WebSocket, publish, subscribe and request/response.

Java

  • PLCcom MQTT for Java - Commercial MQTT client and broker SDK for Java with MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0, TLS, WebSocket and an embeddable broker.

C# / .NET

  • PLCcom MQTT for .NET - Commercial MQTT client and broker SDK for .NET with MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0, TLS, WebSocket and an embeddable broker.

Industry / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

  • tagbridge (⭐0) - Config-driven Modbus and OPC UA to MQTT gateway with Sparkplug B and Unified Namespace output.

Monitoring / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

  • iotaudit (⭐13) - Local CLI that grades your own smart home devices and publishes the results to MQTT with Home Assistant discovery.

Visualization, Dashboards / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

  • MQTT Dash 2 - Android app for building dashboards for MQTT smart home devices and applications. Successor of MQTT Dash, by the same developer.
  • Routix Dash - iPhone and iPad app for live dashboards from MQTT brokers, HTTP APIs, WebSocket and Server-Sent Events, with charts, gauges, switches and sliders that publish back.

14. Awesome Neovim

Remote Development / Indent

  • mistgc/sshdev.nvim (⭐3) - Happily develop on a remote machine, similar to VSCode's "Remote-SSH" plugin.

15. Free for Dev

Code Quality

  • CodePeel - Automated code reviews for GitHub pull requests that catch bugs and open fix PRs. Free forever for unlimited public and private repositories (30 reviews/month).

Monitoring

  • Pingaroo - 1 website, 2 URLs, uptime check with 15 minutes interval, SSL/DNS/domain checks, email alerts, no credit card needed.

Education and Career Development

  • SharpSkill - Free tier of a technical interview preparation platform including cheatsheets, flashcards, tests and code review exercises in 20 technologies, plus public job market data by technology and country.

16. Urban and Regional Planning Resources

Public Data Resources / Demographic

  • LandScan - ORNL's annual, high-resolution global population dataset (since 2000) mapping where people are likely to be over a 24-hour period.

Public Data Resources / Resilience and Natural Hazards

  • SHIELDUS - This is a county-level U.S. database of natural hazard events from 1960 to the present. It covers thunderstorms, hurricanes, floods, wildfires, tornadoes, flash floods and heavy rainfall, and records each event's date, the affected county and state, and its direct losses in property damage, crop damage, injuries and fatalities.

17. Awesome Go

Security

  • gmrtd (⭐38) - Library for reading and verifying ePassports and ID cards (ICAO Doc 9303) over NFC, including PACE/BAC access control and passive, active and chip authentication.

18. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Writing

  • Meboki - Open-source grammar checker that runs a local model on your Mac and fixes text in any app.

Developer Tools / IDEs

  • Alook - Open-source, local-first group chat where people and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex work together in shared rooms.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • AppuBot - Open-source (Apache 2.0) team of AI bots, each with its own job, that hand tasks to each other and work in your real apps and files, on the Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok or Copilot plan you already have.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • CutVoke (⭐49) - Open-source, local-first video editor with a built-in MCP server, so AI agents and you edit the same multi-track timeline.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Relaycat (⭐0) - Runs several Claude desktop accounts, switches between them in one click, brings chats along and shows each account's session and weekly limits.
  • CablePeek - Shows the USB-C link speed at the screen edge next to the port when you plug in, with eject on hover.

Utilities / File Organization Tools

  • Tidywise (⭐3) - Local-first menu bar app that sorts loose Mac files into Markdown-indexed topic folders with Ollama, with full undo and a read-only MCP server for AI assistants.

Utilities / Productivity

  • VYSHYVKA BAR - Open-source Touch Bar replacement with animated Ukrainian embroidery, weather forecast, and system controls.

Utilities / Window Management

  • AutoWindow - Open-source menu bar app that restores window layouts per monitor setup and per Mission Control desktop.

19. Awesome Testing

Software / Security Testing

  • VibeRaven (⭐65) - Open-source CLI that checks Supabase migrations for missing RLS and grants, and replays two concurrent requests on a fresh PostgreSQL to reproduce a bug and confirm its fix.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • EvalShift (⭐16) - Open-source CLI for regression testing LLM apps and agents before a model change: replays the same cases on two models and reports which outputs and tool calls regressed.

Software / Visual Testing

  • pdf-snapshot-testing (⭐0) - Visual snapshot testing library for PDFs on the JVM (Kotlin & Java / JUnit 5).

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • Agentic Test Explorer (⭐37) - Open-source (MIT) AI exploratory testing framework: LangGraph persona agents drive a real browser through a deterministic Playwright engine, and every bug found becomes a reproducible Playwright spec. Can generate test missions from a GitHub pull request.

Software / Test Management

  • Gitoza (⭐4) - Open-source desktop test and task management that stores tickets, wiki, cases, and runs as Markdown in Git.

Software / Browser Extensions & Utilities

  • Deep Link Tester - Builds shell-safe adb and xcrun simctl commands and a QR code for testing Android and iOS deep links, and shows which intent filter in a pasted manifest catches a link.

Blogs / Static Analysis

  • AI Testing Guide

20. Awesome Mac

System Tools / System Utilities

  • gbammc/Thor (⭐1.3k) — Switch the right application ASAP ☆1,331

Terminal / Emulators

  • novadeck-org/novadeck (⭐59) — Runs Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and opencode side by side ☆63

🌱 50 rising / Shell Utilities

  • mxpalm/AerialSwap (⭐8) — Turn any video into a native macOS Aerial wallpaper ☆8
  • jazzyalex/stargazer-bar (⭐7) — Track one public GitHub repo's stars and release downloads from the menu bar. ☆7
  • reathloo/smartClip (⭐10) — Encrypted local clipboard history with sensitive-data protection. ☆10

entry.content:
1. Awesome Mysql

Binlog-Replication

  • OLake (⭐2.3k) - Binlog-based CDC and full-load replication from MySQL to Apache Iceberg or Parquet, without Kafka or Spark

2. Awesome Readme

Examples

  • QuangquyNguyenvo/Sameko-Dev-CPP (⭐116) - A cute ocean-themed README with animated custom illustrations, playful section headers, a GIF demo and live download badges.

3. Awesome Opentofu

Tools / CI

  • cloud-drift-report (⭐3) - Read-only drift report for OpenTofu and Terraform (plan -refresh-only), plus AWS resources that no state file covers.

4. Awesome Rails

Gems / Other external resources

  • openreceive-rails (⭐32) - A gem to accept Bitcoin Lightning payments in Rails apps, paid straight into your own wallet. 🔴

5. Awesome Fiber

⚙️ Middlewares / 🧬 Core

  • Deprecation (⭐40k) - Marks routes as deprecated or scheduled for removal with the Deprecation (RFC 9745) and Sunset (RFC 8594) headers.

6. Free Programming Books (English, By Subjects)

Misc / Mathematics For Computer Science

  • 10 Keys to Great Landing Pages - iThemes Media (PDF) ( 🗃️ archived)

7. Awesome Esports

Applications & Tools / Tournaments management

  • Clips Kitty (⭐635) - A Windows app that turns esports and gaming stream VODs from Twitch, Kick and YouTube into captioned vertical highlight clips.

8. Awesome Tmux

AI agent management

  • forestui (⭐26) A Rust TUI for managing Git worktrees in tmux, with Claude Code session tracking and GitHub issue integration
  • tmux-claude-status-tabs (⭐5) Per-window Claude Code session state in the tab bar: animated spinner, input, permission and done indicators. Event-driven via hooks, no polling.

9. Awesome Css

Miscellaneous / Editor's Draft ✒️

  • CSSnippets - A collection of HTML, React, CSS and Tailwind CSS code snippets for buttons, box-shadows, cards, checkboxes, dropdowns and many more.

10. Awesome for Beginners

JavaScript

  • Img2Num (⭐126) (label: good first issue)
    Cross-platform raster-to-SVG vectorization library designed for natural images.

11. Awesome Rust

Applications / Productivity

  • naxhq/NexQ (⭐151) - Live transcription of both sides of a call, with answers from your own notes, for Windows and macOS.

Libraries / Graphics

  • Fonts
    • harfbuzz/harfrust (⭐331) [harfrust] - A port of HarfBuzz's text shaping engine to Rust
    • redox-os/rusttype (⭐640) - Alternative to libraries like FreeType

12. Awesome Datascience

Books / Visualization Tools

  • Causal Inference for Data Science - Early Access

13. Awesome Playcanvas

PlayCanvas Products

  • create-playcanvas (⭐63) - CLI that scaffolds a Vite-powered PlayCanvas project with TypeScript.
  • Model Viewer - Open source model viewer for viewing glTF and PLY (3D Gaussian Splats) files.
  • SuperSplat (⭐11k) - Open source editor for 3D Gaussian Splats.
  • SplatTransform (⭐1.5k) - Open source CLI tool and library for processing and converting 3D Gaussian Splats.

Tutorials

  • Official Tutorials - Large collection of official PlayCanvas tutorials.
  • Publishing on Wavedash - Official guide to publishing PlayCanvas games on Wavedash.
  • YouTube Playables Template (⭐133) - Official starter project for building YouTube Playables.

Games / IO Games

  • Bullet Bonanza - Fast-paced, high-fidelity, 3D multiplayer FPS game from Kiloo.
  • Fields of Fury - Capture the flag set during WW2.
  • Warbands - 3D multiplayer first-person shooter.

14. Awesome Cl

Online editors / Third-party APIs

  • OnlineCompiler.io is an online editor which supports Common Lisp (SBCL 2.6), with standard input. Free, no sign-up.

15. Open Source Mac Os Apps

🎵 Audio (117)

  • AudioSmith (⭐256) - Offline voice studio for Apple silicon: text to speech, voice cloning, audiobooks, video dubbing and transcripts with speakers. (Website) — Go Swift
  • VoiceInk (⭐7.1k) - Open-source macOS dictation with on-device speech recognition and app-specific modes. (Website) — Swift

🎬 Video (60) / ✏️ Text (20)

  • LocalScribe (⭐27) - On-device speech-to-text for microphone, system audio and media files using Apple Speech, Whisper, SenseVoice or Parakeet, with floating live captions, a subtitle editor, offline translation and subtitle burn-in. (Website) — Swift

⏱️ Productivity (283) / ✏️ Text (20)

  • mm2t (⭐22) - Meeting recorder with local storage and on-device speaker recognition, using your chosen services for transcripts and summaries. (Website) — Swift
  • AFFiNE (⭐74k) - Open source knowledge base combining docs, a whiteboard and databases. (Website) — TypeScript

🎧 Music (34) / ✏️ Text (20)

  • MySpotify (⭐235) - Unofficial lightweight native Spotify desktop client built with Go (MyGo), featuring floating desktop lyrics, synced lyrics fallback, music videos, video podcasts, AppleScript support, and notch mini-player. (Website) — Go

⬇️ Downloader (17) / 📱 iOS / macOS (48)

  • Prism (⭐902) - Download manager that splits each file over up to 32 connections, resumes after a crash, catches downloads from the browser and saves video or MP3 through yt-dlp, with torrents, queues and a scheduler. (Website) — Rust TypeScript

🛠️ Utilities (389) / ✏️ Text (20)

  • Voxt (⭐890) - Voice input for macOS on local models: transcribe, translate and rewrite by voice in any app. (Website) — Go Swift
  • Mythpen (⭐110) - Open-source AI-assisted novel writing desktop app with chapter management, world-building, characters, and timeline. The AI agent writes directly into your project. (Website) — TypeScript Rust JavaScript

16. Awesome Mac

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Kapitsa (⭐870) - Open-source LLM inference engine for Apple silicon, built on native Metal kernels and the Neural Engine, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs and one-command local coding agents.
  • SpecWithCode - Open-source (MIT) desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot threads side by side, with a project coordinator and one git worktree per task.

Developer Tools / API Development and Analysis

  • CurlGo - Open-source API client for HTTP, SSE and WebSocket that keeps workspaces on your Mac and imports curl, Postman and Bruno collections.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Vaquero (⭐0) - Learns a face from a few photos, then finds every photo and video of that person in your folders, fully offline.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • Nuclear - Streaming music player that finds free music for you.
  • MySpotify - Unofficial lightweight native Spotify desktop client built in Go (MyGo), with floating desktop lyrics, synced lyrics fallback, music videos, video podcasts, and notch player.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Cue - Desktop AI assistant for voice typing, meeting transcription, and supported agent tasks using context you provide.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Out to Sea - Menu bar break reminders: a live-rendered sea fills the screen when it is time to look into the distance, then guides a minute of slow breathing.
  • Roomie - A pair of cartoon eyes that lives in the menu bar, reacts to what you do, and pops out of the notch to remind you to rest your eyes, take a walk and go to bed.

Utilities / General Tools

  • Verticar (⭐2) - Open-source app for using an iPad as a portrait second display over Sidecar.

17. Awesome Privacy

Download Manager / Useful Tools

  • AB Download Manager - Download manager with queues, scheduling and a browser extension that hands downloads to the app. Desktop · Android · Apache-2.0

  • MathLive - Web component for editing and displaying math with LaTeX, including virtual keyboards and MathML/speech export.

LaTeX-focused

  • BakomaTex - Commercial LaTeX editor that allows to edit your document both using its source code and WYSIWYG.
  • Gummi (⭐802) - Simple GTK LaTeX editor with a continuously updating live preview pane.
  • Texpile - Free and open-source desktop editor that edits LaTeX visually (like LyX) or by source with IntelliSense, with local compilation and built-in Git. Also supports Typst and Markdown.
  • LaTeX Editor (⭐34) - Single-executable desktop editor with live PDF preview, two-way SyncTeX, LaTeX-aware spell checking, and one-key project snapshots written as a standard Git repository. Needs a separate TeX distribution.
  • ModernTex - Native macOS LaTeX editor for academic writing, with synced source and PDF, plain-language error messages, submission-readiness checks, a visual TikZ designer and a table editor. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time $19.99.

Online editors

  • SciTeX Cloud (⭐2) - Self-hostable online editor with AI assistant integration, figure/table/citation management, real-time collaboration, and an MCP server (29 tools).
  • TeXlyre - Local-first, open-source browser editor for LaTeX with in-browser WebAssembly compilation, offline editing, and peer-to-peer collaboration via WebRTC.
  • CoCalc - Collaborative online LaTeX editor with real-time editing, TimeTravel history, and first-class SageTeX, PythonTeX, and Knitr support. Freemium.
  • VerbTeX - LaTeX editor for the browser plus native Android, iOS, and Windows apps, with optional offline compilation on device. Freemium.
  • Murfy - Online LaTeX editor with real-time collaboration and built-in AI assistance for writing and error fixing. Freemium.
  • Aldine - Self-hosted online editor with real-time collaboration in which every project is a Git repository, with branches in the editor and push/pull to GitHub, GitLab and Gitea.

Bibliography tools

  • Bibdesk - Great bibliography editor for .
  • betterbib (⭐841) - Command-line utility for improving your BibTeX files. Fetches information from online sources.
  • CrossRef Local (⭐5) - Local CrossRef database (167M papers) with full-text search, impact factor data, Python API for bibliography enrichment, and an MCP server (15 tools).
  • OpenAlex Local (⭐4) - Local OpenAlex database (284M scholarly works) with abstracts and semantic search for literature discovery, and an MCP server.
  • Biber - Modern bibliography processor for biblatex, with Unicode support and more flexible sorting than BibTeX.
  • BiblioAudit (⭐1) - Command-line tool to check, verify, and repair citations in BibTeX files across 12+ academic databases.
  • latexci BibTeX tools - Browser-based .bib cleaner (removes duplicates, normalizes author names, escapes special characters) plus DOI, arXiv, PubMed and ISBN to BibTeX lookups, with no install and no account.

Build Tools

  • TeXLive.net - Public compile service (used by LearnLaTeX.org) that turns an HTTP POST of a LaTeX document into a PDF.
  • LaTeX.Online - Cloud compiler that builds a PDF from a Git repository, a URL, or pasted TeX; also available as a self-hosted Docker image.

Misc. Tools

  • SciTeX Writer (⭐4) - Manuscript compilation system with templates for manuscripts, revisions, and supplementary materials, plus figure, table, and citation handling, and an MCP server (38 tools).
  • Kroki - Unified HTTP API that renders text-based diagrams, including PGF/TikZ, to SVG, PNG, or PDF. Self-hostable.

Quality Check Tools

  • blacktex (⭐159) - Command-line tool that replaces commonly occurring LaTeX anti-patterns and cleans up your files.
  • paper-preflight (⭐216) - Checks every cited reference of a LaTeX project against Crossref, dblp, arXiv, DataCite, PubMed and OpenAlex records (existence, metadata mismatches, retractions) and reports undefined, duplicate and unused citation keys. Also available as a pre-commit hook, GitHub Action and MCP server.

Tools centered around equations

  • LaTeXEqEdit - LaTeX formula editor for Windows.
  • Mathpix - OCR app and API that converts images and PDFs of printed or handwritten equations, tables, and text into LaTeX. Freemium; paid Pro and API.
  • IguanaTex (⭐1.5k) - PowerPoint add-in that inserts LaTeX equations typeset by your local TeX distribution and keeps the source with each shape, so you can edit and re-typeset it later.
  • MathPoint - PowerPoint and Word add-in that typesets LaTeX equations, TikZ figures and tables on a server, so no local TeX installation is needed. Freemium.

LaTeX-compatible GUI tools

  • TikzEdt (also: GitHub repo (⭐10)) - WYSIWYG and text-based editor for TikZ pictures.
  • RustFig - xfig rebuilt for Windows, macOS, Linux and the browser (no X server): LaTeX text typeset on the canvas, and every fig2dev export built in (TikZ, PSTricks, pict2e, pstex/pdftex, PDF, EPS, SVG). Reads and writes xfig's .fig files.

Tables

  • csv2latex - Converts CSV files from your favorite programs to LaTeX tabulars.

Graphics / TikZ

  • TeXample - Blog about LaTeX, with a big collection of TikZ figures.
  • pgfplots - Truly awesome plotting library on top of and in the style of TikZ/pgf. This library can load in CSV data files, perform some calculations and create beautiful plots.
  • TikZJax - Renders TikZ diagrams to SVG in the browser by running TeX via WebAssembly.

Templates / TikZ

  • LaTeX templates - Collection of templates for papers, posters, resumés, theses, books, presentations, … for LaTeX.

Resources / TikZ

  • BibTeX Style Examples - Example output of common BibTeX styles (BST files).

Books / TikZ

  • Formatting Information (2020) - This is the HTML5-based online version of the book Formatting Information - An introduction to typesetting with LATEX. It has been continuously updated since the early 2000s.

5. Awesome Analytics

General analytics

  • Eventkiwi - Event aggregation and reporting platform: send events from any service through one HTTP API and get scheduled reports, with an AI summary built on exact counts, by email or Telegram. © SaaS
  • North Metric - Churn analytics for SaaS on Stripe. Scores each customer's churn risk and ranks them by revenue at risk. © SaaS

SEO

  • Firecrawl Alexandria - Website traffic and engagement (Similarweb) and Wayback Machine snapshots as tools AI agents can call through one Firecrawl API key, CLI or MCP server. © SaaS

Privacy focused analytics

  • Owlytics - Small, cookieless web analytics with one Rust executable and one SQLite database. No stored raw IP addresses. (Source Code (⭐5)) MIT Self-Hosted Rust
  • Highseat - Cookieless web analytics with revenue by source: connects to your payment provider and shows which traffic sources bring paying customers. Public API and MCP server. © SaaS

Analytics layers

  • hypequery - Open-source embedded analytics layer for ClickHouse. Define metrics and dimensions once in TypeScript or Python, then serve them as type-safe queries, authenticated HTTP APIs, React hooks and MCP tools for AI agents from your own backend. (Source Code (⭐106)) Apache-2.0 TypeScript/Python

Attribution tracking

  • Improvado - Marketing analytics platform that combines ad, web analytics and CRM data for cross-channel reporting and attribution, with an MCP server for AI agents. © SaaS

Social media analytics

  • Social Fetch - Social media data API: public profiles, posts, comments and transcripts from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit and LinkedIn as JSON. © SaaS

Developer analytics

  • Aidealy - Measures the productivity of engineers and AI agents from the code they ship: a rank per engineer, how much of the code AI wrote, and AI token cost per pull request. © SaaS
  • Weave - Engineering analytics for code output, review quality, and AI-tool usage and costs. © SaaS

Analytics dashboards

  • Web-to-Web BI Board - Cohort ROAS and LTV dashboard for subscription web funnels: payback from day 0 to day 360, sBG forecasts with 80 % intervals, real-time spend and a funnel map. Static, reads one JSON file, no backend. (Demo, Source Code (⭐0)) MIT JavaScript

6. Awesome Testing

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • Mockatoo - Free hosted mock OAuth provider for Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Apple and four other providers, so E2E tests in Playwright, Cypress or CI can sign in without real accounts, CAPTCHAs or app registration.
  • sitelooper (⭐1) - Open-source (MIT) CLI that records a browser flow from plain-English steps with an LLM agent, then compiles it into a standalone Playwright spec that runs in CI with no model, and repairs the spec when the app changes.

Software / Test Report Diagnostics

  • pytest-glow-report (⭐4) - Open source (MIT) pytest plugin that writes HTML and JSON reports and keeps run history in SQLite.

7. Static Analysis

Multiple languages / Other

  • REA — Local CLI and MCP server for static analysis of native binaries, .NET assemblies, and JavaScript and Electron bundles. Reports binary hardening flags, dependencies, and release exposure such as shipped source maps, with supporting evidence. The release audit can fail a build at a chosen severity.

8. Awesome Rust

Development tools / Transpiling

  • erkamyaman/rust-anything (⭐5.2k) [rust-anything] - Ports TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java apps to Rust piece by piece, checking each piece against the recorded behavior of the original.

Libraries / Configuration

  • hyperi-io/scalo-rs (⭐0) [scalo] - Runtime for Rust services. It has layered config, redacted structured logs and health probes. It supports Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics. Its transports are Kafka, gRPC and HTTP.

9. Awesome Python Typing

Stub packages

  • jaxtyping (⭐1.9k) - Enhanced type annotations for PyTorch, Numpy, Jax, etc.

10. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • Wiro AI (⭐1) - Gemini CLI extension for the hosted Wiro AI MCP server (https://mcp.wiro.ai/v1): run 1,000+ image, video, audio and LLM models, build and run workflows, and deploy and message AI agents from Gemini CLI. Ships five Agent Skills, including project media assets (images, icons, short videos, voice-overs and 3D models placed where the framework expects them) and realtime voice. Paid runs bill your Wiro AI wallet and show the price before they start. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/wiroai/Wiro-Plugin, then /mcp auth wiro to sign in.

MCP Servers

  • ClickHouse Loom (⭐168) - Shared long-term memory, document search and a code index for Gemini CLI through a self-hosted Loom MCP server. Install the release-candidate extension: gemini extensions install https://github.com/ClickHouse/loom --ref v1.3.0-rc.1.
  • Brilliant (⭐1) - MCP server that lets Gemini CLI create and edit vector designs on a Brilliant canvas you edit by hand at the same time. Install: gemini mcp add brilliant -- npx -y @brilliant-hq/mcp.

Documentation & Examples

  • Video skills and MCP servers for coding agents (Takes) - 47 skills, MCP servers and tools for making video with Gemini CLI and other agents, each with its install line.

11. Magictools

Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

  • 💸 Gridwright - Pixel-art game asset packs on one grid (tilesets, characters, UI, icons, effects, isometric, music and SFX) for any engine, many with Godot scenes and Tiled tilesets. Each pack has a free sample.

12. Awesome Neovim

AI / Diagnostics

  • ~foosoft/boomer.nvim - Minimalist agent chat buffer for Codex and ACP agents such as Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, and Claude Agent.

Language / Markdown and LaTeX

  • refine-sh/refine.nvim (⭐6) - Grammar and fluency checks with a local LLM, powered by the Refine app for macOS.

13. Free for Dev

Source Code Repos

  • Upstream - Over 10,000 pushes/sec, the fastest Git host. 100 free repos, public or private, with LFS, merge checks, semantic code search, and AI

APIs, Data, and ML

  • Context.dev - Web scraping API with 1,000 API credits per month (1,000 standard scrapes) plus 10,000 one-time Logo Link requests, no credit card required.
  • CurrencyBeacon - Realtime currency data API for fintech apps. The free plan includes 5,000 calls per month.

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • Fibery - Connected workspace platform. Free for single users, up to 2 GB disk space.

Code Quality

  • DeepSource - DeepSource continuously analyzes source code changes, finding and fixing issues categorized under security, performance, anti-patterns, bug-risks, documentation, and style. Native integration with GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.

Email

  • turboSMTP - SMTP relay service, free for 200 emails per day or 6000 emails per month, free forever, no time limit, no expiry. Web API, SPF/DKIM authentication, suppression management, 1 sending domain, 2 API keys, 2FA, ticket and chat support, GDPR compliant.

Forms

  • FormTango - Form backend for static sites and AI-built apps. Free plan: 100 submissions a month, unlimited forms, spam filtering and email notifications. Endpoints can be created from the API with no account.
  • Kwes.io - Feature rich form endpoint. Works great with static sites. The free plan includes up to 1 website with up to 50 monthly submissions.

BaaS

  • IFTTT - Automate your favorite apps and devices. Free 2 Applets

Managed Data Services

  • CrateDB - Distributed Open Source SQL database for real-time analytics. Free Tier CRFREE: One-node with 2 CPUs, 2 GiB of memory, 8 GiB of storage. One cluster per organization, no payment method needed.

14. Awesome Go

Search and Analytic Databases

  • riot (⭐6.1k) - Simple and fast text and vector index engine.

Messaging

  • goncordia (⭐70) - Background job queue on the database you already use (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis and more), with transactional enqueue and typed futures.

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • TernaryCode - Terminal workspace for many projects and the coding agents in them that shows which agent is waiting for you.

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • Meridian - Open-source Arc-style browser on Chromium with spaces, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click Arc and Chrome import, and a built-in MCP server for AI agents.

Proxy and VPN Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • unbraid - Per-app VPN client. Each app can use its own exit or skip the VPN, while Tailscale stays on.

Utilities / Clipboard Tools

  • Tietie (⭐0) - Open-source clipboard history for Mac and Windows with number-key pasting and search for text inside images, with an interface in Traditional Chinese.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Deskbridge - Menu bar app that opens a Samsung Galaxy phone's DeX desktop in a Mac window over USB or Wi-Fi, with phone apps in their own windows, call banners and notifications.
  • SIAM.AI GPU Watch (⭐0) - Menu bar app for monitoring NVIDIA GPUs across remote servers over SSH.

Utilities / File Organization Tools

  • DropKeeper - Open-source app that gives every new download an expiry and moves expired files to the Trash, with Undo.

Utilities / General Tools

  • Driftwall - Play any video file as a looping live wallpaper behind your desktop icons, on every display.

Utilities / Window Management

  • HyprMac - Keyboard-driven tiling window manager inspired by Hyprland, with automatic dwindle layout and ten workspaces.

16. Awesome Mac

Audio & Video / Players

  • vespertineapp/Vespertine (⭐33) — Free, open-source, surround bit-perfect music player for Mac ☆41

Browser Extensions / Nevix

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 18, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Qubes OS

Customization

  • Multiload-Qubes (⭐3) - Qubes OS XFCE panel plugin: system monitor with scrolling charts for CPU, RAM, swap, network, and disk i/o

2. awsm.fish

Plugins

  • Web Search (⭐23) - A plugin to search the web from Fish. Inspired by oh-my-zsh/web-search

3. Awesome Transit

GTFS Realtime Libraries & Demo Apps / Rust

  • gtfs-realtime-php (⭐0) - PHP bindings generated from the official GTFS-realtime protocol buffer specification (⭐1.1k), kept current with the spec and on a supported google/protobuf runtime. Available on Packagist as a drop-in replacement for lowa/gtfs-realtime-php.

4. Awesome R Learning Resources

Blogs / Uncategorized

  • Tidy Ecology - Free R tutorials for ecologists, from diversity indices and ordination to occupancy, capture-recapture and population models, each with runnable code and a downloadable R script.

5. Awesome Osint

Data Breach Search Engines

  • Vendor History - Check whether a software vendor a business uses has been breached: state breach notices, SEC cyber filings, CISA exploited flaws and ransomware claims for 255 vendors, each linked to its source. Free, no signup.

Company Research / GitHub

  • Lacis - Free, open-source desktop tool for Linux and Windows that maps French companies, their directors and addresses into a sourced link graph from the national company register and the BODACC, and flags patterns such as mass domiciliation or phoenix schemes. Interface in French.

Geospatial Research and Mapping Tools / GitHub

  • Street Crime Map - Street-level police records for England, Wales and Northern Ireland counted by area and category, with coverage notes.

6. Awesome Rust

Applications

  • lthoangg/openagentd (⭐216) - A local coding agent as a desktop app (Tauri) and CLI with a native Rust backend; shows every tool call, diff and shell command, and works with your own model keys or local models
  • VinceGHER/openwren (⭐94) - Privacy-first desktop mail client for Gmail and IMAP that keeps mail encrypted on your computer, built with Tauri

Applications / File manager

  • Koimsurai/Arke (⭐232) - A file explorer for Windows that never freezes, GPU-rendered with GPUI

Applications / Utilities

  • Multron-Community/Multron-Download-Manager (⭐25) - Cross-platform download manager built with Tauri that splits files into parallel connections, with browser integration, yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and BitTorrent support.

Libraries / Audio and Music

  • gradium-ai/xn-ptts (⭐509) [ptts] - Streaming inference for Phonon text-to-speech models on CPU, GPU, mobile devices, and browsers

7. Awesome Agriculture

Automation and Robotics

  • Sowbot (⭐104) - Open-hardware seeding and weeding robot for smallholder agroecological farms, with a ROS 2 stack.

Climate, Environment and Weather

  • MAgPIE (⭐145) - Global land-use allocation model linking agricultural production, land use and environmental impacts.
  • SoilHive Core (⭐9) - Federated platform for discovering, harmonising and sharing soil datasets across institutions.

Crop Modeling, Phenotyping, and Pathology

  • apsimNGpy (⭐37) - Python interface for running and analysing APSIM Next Generation simulations.
  • CroptimizR (⭐32) - R package for parameter estimation and uncertainty analysis of crop models.
  • DSSAT (⭐240) - Decision Support System for Agrotechnology Transfer cropping system model.
  • Epicrop.jl - Crop disease epidemic simulation using a compartmental (HLIP) model, in Julia.
  • FielDHub (⭐60) - R/Shiny app for designing agricultural field experiments.
  • Phenomenal (⭐45) - 3D plant phenotyping and organ segmentation from multi-view images.
  • PlantGL (⭐81) - Geometric library for modelling and visualising plant architecture.

Data Standardization, Interoperability and APIs / United States

  • FoodOn (⭐249) - Open ontology for food, food sources and food processing.

Farm Management Systems and Record Keeping / United States

  • AnimalTrakker - Mobile record keeping for sheep and goat flocks.
  • DigiAgriApp - Field and orchard data management server with sensor and remote-sensing integration.

IoT, Hardware / United States

  • Mycodo (⭐3.3k) - Environmental monitoring and regulation for mushrooms, hydroponics and greenhouses.
  • OpenSprinkler (⭐569) - Firmware for the open irrigation controller.
  • Smart Irrigation (⭐572) - Home Assistant integration that schedules irrigation from evapotranspiration.

Markets and Food Systems / United States

  • FoodCoopShop (⭐124) - Ordering and stock software for food co-ops and local farm shops.
  • foodsharing - Platform behind foodsharing.de, coordinating volunteers who rescue surplus food.
  • Foodsoft (⭐361) - Ordering, accounting and member management for non-profit food co-ops.
  • Juntagrico (⭐55) - Management platform for community-supported agriculture: memberships, shares, deliveries and work shifts.
  • Karrot - Organising tool for grassroots groups that save and share food.
  • Open Food Network (⭐1.3k) - Online marketplace for farmers and food hubs to sell directly to eaters.
  • OpenOlitor (⭐20) - Administration software for community-supported agriculture initiatives.
  • Teikei (⭐66) - Map platform connecting consumers with community-supported agriculture (CSA) farms.

Remote Sensing and Imagery / United States

  • OpenDroneMap (⭐6.6k) - Drone image processing into orthomosaics, elevation models and plant health maps.
  • WebODM (⭐4.3k) - Web interface for processing and sharing OpenDroneMap drone surveys.

8. Awesome Zig

Fundamentals / Text Editors

  • jinzhongjia/zig-analyzer (⭐4) - A language server (LSP) for Zig, built on an incremental query engine. AI-generated.

Network & Web / Web Framework

  • deatil/zig-vin (⭐1) - A template render library like jinja2 for zig. AI-assisted.

Multimedia & Graphics / GUI

  • JonathanRiche/verde (⭐35) - Native multi-agent coding desktop workspace. Use with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok and OpenCode. AI-generated.

9. Awesome Mac

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • NotchDeck (⭐5) - Control center around the MacBook notch with system metrics, media controls, quick notes, screen recording and task profiles.
  • DisplayLatch - Keeps external monitors connected after sleep and restart, with DDC brightness, resolution and disconnect-without-unplugging controls.
  • YANA (⭐1) - Turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island for media, volume and brightness HUDs, notifications, Messages, iPhone calls, calendar, weather, timers, and a file shelf.

Reading and Writing Tools / Markdown Tools

  • Inkstone (砚台) (⭐1) - Open-source Markdown workspace with a wiki built from selected notes and AI answers that cite original passages (source preview for Apple Silicon).

Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

  • Pinto Notes - Open-source notes app that ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants can search and edit over MCP, with each AI edit highlighted and undoable.

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • ClaudeTTY (⭐22) - Native macOS terminal for running lots of Claude Code at once, where every tab keeps running after the app quits.

Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

AI Tools / Other Tools

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Point - Open-source push-to-talk dictation that also lets you circle part of the screen while you talk, sending your words plus a marked-up screenshot to Claude Code, Cursor, or any chat, transcribed on-device.

Translation Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Tomoru - Live bilingual subtitles for streams, anime, games, and meetings, plus instant screen text translation — works offline on your Mac or in the cloud, with glossaries that keep character names right.

Utilities / Finder Tools

  • Treewise - File manager that works like Windows Explorer: a folder tree, cut and paste, and two windows side by side.

10. Awesome Polars

Polars plugins / Finance

  • fin-primitives (⭐16) - Trading indicators from a Rust core with a pl.col(...).fp expression namespace (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, works per group with .over()) and a df.fp DataFrame namespace (ATR, MACD, Bollinger Bands) by @Mattbusel.

MCP Servers

Paid from $29/month, 7-day trial; a demo server with sample errors needs no account. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/getrunheed/runheed-plugin

12. Magictools

Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

  • 🆓 CC0 Materials - Free CC0 PBR textures for game environments, up to 4K with OpenGL and DirectX normal maps for Unity, Unreal and Godot.
  • 🆓 Iconito Game Food Icons - Food icons for cooking, farming and cozy games, free under the MIT license as SVG, in Figma and on Iconify.

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🆓 SpritePacker - Free browser sprite sheet packer with Compact (MaxRects), Grid, Horizontal and Vertical layouts, padding, extrude and trim. Exports PNG sheets with JSON Hash (Phaser, PixiJS), TexturePacker Generic XML or CSS/SCSS, or as an animated GIF. Frames are packed on your device; no account needed.
  • 🆓 Voidless Sprite Sheet Tools - Free browser sprite sheet cutter/slicer and packer: cut a sheet into frames, or pack sprites into one atlas with PNG and Phaser/PixiJS JSON output. No account needed; files stay in the browser.

Graphics / Modeling

  • 💸 Trify3D - Browser-based AI 3D generator that runs Tripo3D, Meshy and Rodin side by side and exports game-ready GLB and OBJ assets.

Graphics / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 Voidless Voxel Editor - Browser voxel editor with box, line and mirror tools. Exports MagicaVoxel .vox, GLB, OBJ and PNG, and renders 8-direction pixel art sprites. No account needed.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Gridize - AI pixel art sprite and animation generator: make sprites from a prompt or upload your own, animate idle, attack, spell and turnaround clips of 9 to 49 frames on one consistent pixel grid, and export GIF, WebP, PNG frames or sprite sheets with timing JSON. Free credits on signup.
  • 💸 Voidless - AI game assets: pixel art sprites from 32 to 384 px, sprite animation, 8-direction sprites, tilesets, 3D models, sound and music. Includes an MCP server so Claude Code or Cursor can generate art straight into a project. 60 free credits on sign-up, no subscription.

Collections / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 8-Bit Arcade SFX Free Lite - 24 free 8-bit sound effects (UI, coins, jumps, lasers, jingles) synthesized by code; free for commercial use, no attribution required.

Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 Voidless 8-Bit Sound Generator - sfxr-style retro sound effect generator that runs in the browser. No account needed.

Game Jams / Voxel Editors

  • Fright Queue Horror Jam Tracker - Nightly-updated tracker of horror game jams on itch.io

Project Management / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 Fright Queue Dev Planner - Steam sale and festival calendar for indie devs, with 30-day discount cooldown windows to plan launches and discounts

Tools

  • Katman MQTT - MQTT client for Windows and Linux with reusable publish templates, selected-topic logging, and request/response debugging tools.

14. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • Kardinal - Route optimization API for delivery and field service fleets: multi-vehicle routing with time windows, vehicle capacities and other real-world constraints, also usable by AI agents. Free tier includes 1,000 stops that never expire, no credit card required.

Code Generation

  • v0 - Created by Vercel, v0 generates copy-and-paste friendly React code using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. The free plan includes 7 messages per day, Design Mode and GitHub sync.

Security and PKI

  • Chainguard - Hardened, minimal container images and a software supply chain security platform. The Starter plan is free with no credit card: five users, five container images, 50,000 dependency pulls and 100 GB of artifact storage per month.
  • Safety - Software supply chain security for Python, JavaScript and Docker dependencies. The free plan covers one codebase and 100 scans per month for a single user, for non-commercial use.
  • tridentstack.com - Patch, vulnerability and compliance management for Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints. Free forever for up to 200 endpoints with every feature included, no credit card required.

Log Management

  • Better Stack Logs - ClickHouse-based SQL-compatible log management. The free plan includes 3 GB of logs retained for three days.

Monitoring

  • Uptimeify - Permament free status pages including custom domain, subscribers (mail, slack, teams, webhook and rss) and maintenance with postmortems. Fully hosted inside the EU.

Generative AI

  • Respan - LLM observability and gateway with one format for 200+ models. The free plan includes 100,000 logs, 1,000 scores, five datasets, two evaluators and ten prompts per month, with no credit card required.

PaaS

  • Ravion - Deploy web services, databases, and more on your own AWS account with a Git push style workflow. The Individuals plan is free for one user with up to 50 modules, 2,000 pipeline minutes and $20 of AI tokens per month. AWS costs are billed through AWS, but you can use credits and the AWS free tier.

Payment and Billing Integration

  • Autumn - Billing infrastructure for SaaS: pricing models, entitlements, usage tracking and checkout. The free plan includes 25,000 in monthly billing volume, 10,000 customers and 10 million API requests.

Artificial Intelligence

  • gleann (⭐43) - Local vector search engine, codebase intelligence graph, and persistent memory with MCP support.

🏆 Top 50 by Stars / Shell Utilities

  • scPerturbBench (TianGzlab / PerturbArena) (⭐11) — Benchmark of single-cell genetic perturbation prediction covering unseen perturbations, combinations, cell-state transfer, and 24 evaluation metrics.
  • scPerturBench (BM2 Lab) (⭐110) — Benchmark comparing 27 single-cell perturbation-response prediction methods across 29 genetic and chemical perturbation datasets.

General Biological ML & Knowledge Graph Benchmarks

  • CellBench (CellVoyager) (⭐273) — Benchmark for evaluating LLMs and data-analysis agents on reproducible single-cell research tasks.

Preprocessing Tools

  • SpatialData — Interoperable data structures and tooling for spatial omics, microscopy images, coordinates, segmentation shapes, and annotations.

Bioinformatics & Omics Agents

  • CellVoyager (⭐273) — Jupyter-based scientific agent that plans, executes, and evaluates single-cell transcriptomics analyses, accompanied by CellBench.

Single-cell Foundation Models / Transcriptomics Foundation Models

  • Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale (⭐896) — Single-cell language-model family representing gene-expression profiles as cell sentences for cellular interpretation, generation, and question answering.

Multi-Modal Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

  • TxGemma — Open Gemma-based therapeutic-development model family (2B, 9B, and 27B) for property prediction and interactive scientific reasoning.
  • NVIDIA Nemotron for Science — Scientific-agent development stack based on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, with post-training recipes and chemistry reasoning benchmark LitmusBench v0.2.

2. Awesome Appimage

AppImage developer tools / Deployment tools for compiled applications

  • AppImage Packaging (⭐1) - Skills for Claude and other coding agents (Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, ...) that package Linux applications as self-contained AppImages, build and publish them from GitHub Actions, and verify and troubleshoot them on other distributions.

Server Software / General Purpose

  • FreeSWITCH (⭐5.3k) - Open source communications server for voice, video, messaging and conferencing.
  • Asterisk - PBX framework supporting multiple protocols and platforms.

Server Software / SIP Servers

  • Kamailio - Open source SIP server for routing, registration, presence and large-scale deployments.
  • OpenSIPS - Open source SIP proxy and application server for VoIP platforms.
  • FreeSBC (⭐369) - Open source SIP/WebRTC edge proxy with an embedded RTP relay for FreeSWITCH and Asterisk.
  • P-KISS-SBC (⭐114) - Kamailio and rtpengine-based session border controller for connecting SIP trunks and PBXs.

Server Software / Media Servers

  • LiveKit (⭐22k) - Open source WebRTC server and SDK ecosystem for real-time audio, video and data.
  • rtpengine (⭐1k) - RTP and UDP based media traffic proxy, usable as a kernel module.
  • MediaMTX (⭐21k) - Media server and proxy bridging WebRTC, RTSP, RTMP and SRT streams, with recording and playback.
  • go2rtc (⭐15k) - Camera streaming gateway with WebRTC viewing, RTSP restreaming and two-way audio integrations.

Server Software / STUN/TURN

  • STUNner (⭐1.1k) - Kubernetes-native STUN/TURN gateway for WebRTC media.

Clients / STUN/TURN

  • Web SIP Phone (⭐8) - Chrome extension maintaining SIP/WebRTC audio for server-controlled call center agents.
  • baresip (⭐2.3k) - Modular SIP user agent with command-line controls, audio/video calls and pluggable media modules.

Operations / Monitoring

  • sip-exporter (⭐58) - Open-source eBPF sensor exporting Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for host-observed IPv4/UDP SIP and correlated RTP/RTCP.
  • rtcStats (⭐47) - WebRTC API trace and getStats collection, storage and feature extraction tooling.
  • SIP3 Community Edition - Open source SIP/RTP capture, analysis and monitoring components with community deployment tooling.

Operations / Testing

  • SIPp (⭐1.2k) - Traffic generator and scenario-based test tool for the SIP protocol.

Operations / Web/API Interfaces

  • Kazoo (⭐992) - Legacy open source VoIP API platform built on FreeSWITCH and Kamailio, available in the public 4.3 branch.
  • AI Native Call Center (⭐659) - FreeSWITCH-based call center with speech-to-speech AI, agent queues and a web interface/API.

Operations / Billing

  • CGRateS (⭐528) - Open source rating, charging and billing engine for telecom and ISP services.

Developer Resources / Tutorials

  • WebRTC.org - Official WebRTC guides, APIs and project resources.
  • Getting Started With WebRTC - Official introduction to media capture and peer-to-peer connectivity APIs.
  • WebRTC for the Curious - Open book explaining WebRTC protocols, architecture and practical debugging.

Developer Resources / JavaScript Libraries

  • JsSIP - Open source JavaScript SIP library with WebRTC media support.
  • Peerix (⭐7) - TypeScript WebRTC library for peer-to-peer media and data with pluggable signalling drivers.
  • werift (⭐649) - TypeScript WebRTC implementation for Node.js with media, data channels and RTP/RTCP APIs.

Developer Resources / C/C++ Libraries

  • libre (⭐195) - Portable SIP, SDP, RTP, SRTP and ICE/STUN/TURN library with asynchronous I/O.
  • icey (⭐1.4k) - C++20 media toolkit combining WebRTC, FFmpeg, asynchronous networking and signalling.
  • GStreamer WebRTC - WebRTC elements for connecting native GStreamer media pipelines to browser peers.

Developer Resources / Rust Libraries

  • WebRTC.rs (⭐5.2k) - Asynchronous WebRTC implementation in Rust with SDP, RTP, RTCP and SRTP support.

Developer Resources / Dart Libraries

  • dart-sip-ua (⭐374) - Dart SIP user-agent stack with SIP over WebSocket and WebRTC media support.
  • Flutter WebRTC (⭐4.5k) - WebRTC bindings for Flutter applications on mobile, desktop and the web.

Developer Resources / Media over QUIC

  • moq-rs (⭐186) - Rust implementation of Media over QUIC Transport with a relay and sample publishers.
  • moq (⭐1.6k) - Rust and TypeScript libraries, relay and browser player implementing moq-lite.
  • moqtail (⭐114) - Rust and TypeScript Media over QUIC Transport libraries with a relay and example clients.
  • moxygen (⭐127) - C++ Media over QUIC Transport library with a relay, sample applications and interoperability tools.
  • libquicr (⭐21) - C++ Media over QUIC Transport library with publish, subscribe, capture and replay tools.
  • imquic (⭐82) - Experimental C library for QUIC and WebTransport with RTP over QUIC and Media over QUIC Transport support.

Blogs / Media over QUIC

  • WebRTC For Developers - Articles, examples and tools for WebRTC application developers.

Discussion / Media over QUIC

  • discuss-webrtc - Developer discussion group for WebRTC APIs, implementations and interoperability.

Events and Talks / Media over QUIC

  • ClueCon - Conference for communications and voice AI developers.
  • Kamailio World - Conference announcements and technical sessions covering Kamailio and open source RTC systems.
  • AstriCon - Conference for Asterisk and FreePBX developers and users.
  • CommCon - RTC and open-media community events with a technical talk archive.
  • OpenSIPS Summit - OpenSIPS community conferences with technical presentations and proceedings.
  • JanusCon - Conference proceedings and technical talks for Janus and WebRTC developers.

It integrates of a number of self-developed tools, and also supports dynamic integration of code analysis tools in various programming languages.

10. Awesome Rust

Applications / System tools

  • DuskXi/SpaceKnife (⭐57) - Cross-platform disk usage analyzer with live treemap and flame graph views, NTFS MFT quick scan, scan load limits and snapshot comparison, built with Tauri
  • Ray-lea/Argus (⭐1.4k) - A native Windows task manager built with GPUI Kit, with real-time CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU monitoring, process and service management, file-lock inspection, and resource usage history.

Applications / Text editors

  • thejacedev/Noteriv (⭐112) - A Markdown note-taking app with wiki-links, a graph view, plugins and Git sync, built with Tauri 2.

11. Awesome Mac

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • LazyTune (⭐2) - Lightweight menu bar per-app audio mixer and universal media key controller for web browsers and desktop players.

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • ServerHat (⭐1) - Free menu-bar app that runs your local dev servers. Claude Code and Codex can start, stop and read logs through its MCP server and local API, with your approval.

Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

  • WellSnap - Open-source screenshot tool for macOS and Windows with arrows, numbered callouts, and a blur that never uses the hidden pixels.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • SummonOS - Menu bar app and CLI that gives coding agents live Mac context over MCP and snapshots supported settings changes so they can be undone.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Usagebar - Free native macOS menu bar app that shows Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, z.ai and DeepSeek usage limits, plus when they reset.
  • Daily Wallpaper - Menu bar app that sets the Bing photo of the day as your desktop and lock screen wallpaper.

Utilities / Productivity

  • MagicInput - Share one keyboard and mouse between a Mac and a Windows PC by moving the pointer past the screen edge, with clipboard sync and file transfer.

12. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • Wavegrain (⭐1) - Curated slideshows and carousels for your brand on autopilot, from Gemini CLI: plan posts for a brand, make TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels, change slide text, put posts on the Wavegrain Calendar and export them; Wavegrain schedules and posts them for you. Remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; requires a Wavegrain account. Remote endpoint: https://wavegrain.com/api/mcp. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/wavegrain/wavegrain-mcp, then /mcp auth wavegrain.

MCP Servers

  • ScanMalware (⭐2) - Keyless remote MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for investigating phishing and malicious URLs. Gemini CLI can submit a link to be run in isolated analysis environments and checked against YARA, antivirus and IDS rules, threat feeds and AI (suspicious pages get an AI verdict with a scam type such as credential phishing), then pivot across the public scan archive by domain, IP, ASN, JARM, favicon hash or script hash. A bundled skill walks from one phishing URL to the rest of its campaign. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/scanmalware/scanmalware-plugin

13. Awesome Machine Learning

Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

  • eigenkit (⭐25) - Quantum machine learning in Python: hybrid quantum neural networks as PyTorch modules and quantum kernel models (QSVC/QSVR) with a scikit-learn API, run on PennyLane, Qiskit, CUDA-Q and other simulators or on IBM, IQM and Amazon Braket QPUs.

14. Magictools

Graphics / Animation

  • 💰 Animate4Me - Turns a text prompt or an image into a Spine 4.2 animation with bones and weighted meshes for 2D game symbols, objects and characters; previews in the browser and exports skeleton.json, atlas and PNG pages.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 PlayDrop - Make a browser game by describing it, or publish one your AI app made, and share it with a link.

15. Awesome Mqtt

Platforms

  • AyMON - Industrial monitoring and automation engine with a built-in MQTT 3.1.1 / 5 broker and client: Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP and SQL devices in one live tree with alarms, history, web pages and clustering, configured in XML. A free edition and runnable examples are on GitHub (⭐13).

16. Awesome Neovim

Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX

  • thesimonho/kanagawa-paper (⭐407) - [TS][LSP][L/D][Lua] Remixed light and dark Kanagawa colourschemes with muted colors.

17. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • Beliq - European REST API platform for e-invoicing, including generating, validating and delivering e-invoices. The free plan includes 20 live documents/month, plus 400 sandbox documents/month (no card required).

Email

  • Groundmail - Transactional email API and SMTP relay. 3,000 emails/month free (100/day), three domains, three agent mailboxes, inbound email included.

18. Awesome Go

Interfaces to Multiple Backends

  • dalgo (⭐26) - Database abstraction layer with one API for records, queries and transactions across SQL and NoSQL backends, including Firestore, SQLite, filesystem and in-memory adapters.

Third-party APIs

  • snaprender-go (⭐0) - Go client for the SnapRender screenshot API.

19. Awesome Go

Queues & Pub/Sub / Clients & Libraries

  • cskr/pubsub (⭐454) — A simple pubsub package for go. ☆453

System Tools / Menu Bar
